答案是 C。图片组件（image）中，图片资源通过 image_key（即 img_key）字段引用。 

The field name in the official Lark Card JSON 2.0 schema is "image_key" (used to reference uploaded images via their key after upload), which matches option C (likely an abbreviation in the quiz). Options A/B are web/HTML-style attributes not used in Lark Cards, and D is incorrect as no such "image_id" field exists for this component.
